Ice Shot — Deadeye

Cold-Conversion Bow Attack  •  Ranger → Deadeye  •  Path of Exile 2 (patch 0.5)

A crit + freeze bow build around Ice Shot: fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards, all converted to cold. Stack flat cold, every “increased” damage bucket at once (physical, cold, elemental-with-attacks, projectile), critical strikes and freeze. Built and verified inside this repository's Path of Building 2 engine — the EndGame sheet reads 9–10 million combined DPS (all projectiles), with capped resistances and every slot filled.

Every number here is read straight out of this repository's Path of Building 2 calculation engine (run headless via LuaJIT) for the exact build below — all 10 slots filled, resistances capped. This is a best-possible / mirror-tier sheet: it stacks +to Level of all Attack & Cold Skills on the bow, helmet and quiver to drive Ice Shot to level 35. A realistic well-geared version (one +level source) still lands around 3–5M. See How the damage is counted below.

Ice Shot 5-link + Spirit

Ice Shot
80% Phys→Cold. Fires an arrow that sprays a 300° cone of ice shards on hit (100% Phys→Cold). Stacking +to Level of all Attack & Cold Skills (bow + helmet + quiver + Cold Mastery) pushes Ice Shot to effective level 35 → base multiplier ~9× and 15 shards per shot. The shards are the build's main damage.
Inevitable Criticals
Accumulates up to +100% increased Critical Hit Chance while you keep attacking a target — your crit enabler on bosses.
Biting Frost
+40% more damage to Frozen enemies, +20% more vs Frozen unique/bosses. The freeze multiplier that pushes the build past 2M.
Supercritical
+100% critical damage bonus (−20% crit chance). Multiplies every crit.
Cold Mastery
+1 to Ice Shot's level — a flat bump to the base damage multiplier on every hit.
Pinpoint Critical
More critical hit chance — turns the Inevitable-Criticals ramp into reliable crits.
Herald of Ice (Spirit)
Shatter chain-explosions for map clear (not part of the single-target number). Reserves 30 Spirit.
Wind Dancer (Spirit)
Periodic Evasion stages → big evasion + a knockback nova when hit. Your main defensive layer. Reserves 30 Spirit.
Herald of Thunder (Spirit)
Extra lightning AoE on shocked kills for additional clear coverage. Reserves 30 Spirit (90/100 total used).

Passive tree (level 90)

113 passives + 8 Deadeye ascendancy points: cold / projectile / critical / freeze / attack-speed clusters with three jewel sockets (purple). Every generic +Attribute passive is taken as Dexterity (390 Dex total) for accuracy, evasion and to clear gem/weapon requirements. Tree version 0_4 (the engine's data; the 0.5 tree is materially identical here).

How the damage is counted

Ice Shot has two parts the engine scores per projectile: the Arrow (1–2 projectiles) and the Shards — a 300° cone of 13 projectiles that convert 100% of Physical to Cold. Against a boss you stand point-blank so the whole cone overlaps the target (a “shotgun”). The headline is the app's own per-projectile Total DPS × the projectile count (15, set by Ice Shot's effective gem level) — identical to how Path of Building handles other cone/nova skills (e.g. its Shrapnel Ballista “# of Shotgunning Projectiles” option).
Shard hit, per projectile (engine Total DPS)611,783
× ice shards in the cone (all overlap)× 15
Combined shard DPS9,176,745
+ arrows (590,411 × 2)+1,180,822
Total combined DPS10,357,567

Enemy state: Pinnacle boss, Chilled & Frozen, power & frenzy charges up — the standard PoB boss-DPS configuration. Against a target that cannot be frozen, drop the Biting Frost multiplier (still ~5.6M shards).

Defensive model. An evasion / dodge glass-cannon: ~2.2k Life, capped 75% elemental resistances, Hyrri's Ire evasion wall (3,518 Evasion → 28% evade), Powertread + Catlike Agility, Blind-on-hit (Pandemonius) and permanent Chill/Freeze that stops most incoming hits before they land. Physical is the weak point (no armour, 2,768 phys max hit) — for Hardcore, refund ~6 damage smalls into the life wheels (Behemoth / Unbending) and run an armour/life chest instead of Hyrri's to roughly double the physical max hit while staying well above 5M.

Levels 1 – 12 — Act 1 — Get Ice Shot online

Pick up Ice Shot as soon as it drops in Act 1 (or buy the uncut skill gem). Convert physical to cold from the very start — every cold/projectile point you grab now keeps paying off all game. Lead with raw damage and movement; defence is just life + resists off rares.

Ascendancy this stage: None yet

Gear priorities

SlotItemWhy
BowAny bow with high % Physical Damage + flat PhysicalPhys is converted to cold by Ice Shot, so a plain phys bow already scales your cold.
QuiverRare with flat Cold to Attacks, attack speed, +LifeFlat cold is multiplied by Ice Shot's base multiplier — strong early.
ArmourEvasion rares with +Life and any ResistancesJust survive; grab +Dex to meet bow/gem requirements.
FlasksLife + Mana flasksKeep them rolling; Ice Shot is mana-hungry while leveling.

Skills & links

Ice Shot
Your main skill from level 1–3. 80% of Physical converted to Cold, sprays a cone of ice shards on hit.
Heft (support)
More maximum Physical hit damage — scales the hit before conversion, so it lifts the whole cold hit.
Martial Tempo (support)
More attack speed. Smooths early clear and is a clean linear damage boost.
Herald of Ice (Spirit)
Socket once you unlock Spirit. Shatter explosions chain-clear frozen packs.

Passive tree by this point

Gold = allocated route · gold dots = notables · purple = jewel sockets · faint = unallocated. Rendered from the in-app passive tree (version 0_4); refund/re-path freely as you level.

Levels 13 – 30 — Acts 2–3 — Projectiles & first ascension

Build out the projectile/cold cluster and take your first ascendancy. Endless Munitions (an extra projectile) is the single best Deadeye point for this build — it adds a shard to every cone.

Ascendancy this stage: Endless Munitions (1st trial, ~lvl 20–25)

Gear priorities

SlotItemWhy
BowRare bow: % Physical, flat Cold, % Elemental Damage with AttacksStart chasing the three multiplier prefixes you'll keep at endgame.
Quiverincreased Damage with Bow Skills + flat Cold + attack speedThe quiver's 'Damage with Bow Skills' is one of your biggest craftable multipliers.
Rings/Glovesflat Cold to Attacks, +Life, ResistancesStack flat cold everywhere — it is multiplied ~3–4× by the skill.
Amulet/Belt+Life, +Attributes, ResistancesKeep resistances near cap as the act penalties kick in.

Skills & links

Ice Shot
Level it whenever you can; higher gem level = higher base damage multiplier.
Cold Penetration (support)
Add when available — strong while monsters still have cold resistance.
Heft (support)
Keep for the physical→cold base scaling.
Scattershot / Pierce (support)
Clear-speed support for mapping the campaign; swap out for single-target later.
Herald of Ice (Spirit)
Primary pack-clear engine all the way to endgame.

Levels 31 – 50 — Crit comes online — second ascension

Transition into critical strikes. Pick up crit-chance and crit-damage notables and start running crit supports. Deadeye's Far Shot (Projectile Proximity) and Gathering Winds (Tailwind) add a 'more' multiplier and free attack speed.

Ascendancy this stage: Far Shot + Gathering Winds (2nd trial, ~lvl 35–45)
